products.name: VentSure 4-Foot Strip · 12-inch cap
products.notes: 12-inch shingle-over variant. Narrower versions have different NFA. Cut installed length to suit usable ridge.
products.availability: Roofing distributors; verify variant and local stock.

products.name: VentSure 4-Foot Strip with Weather PROtector · 10-inch cap
products.notes: 10-inch shingle-over variant with Weather PROtector moisture barrier; do not substitute the 12-inch rating.
products.availability: Roofing distributors; verify cap width and local stock.

products.name: Cobra Rigid Vent 3
products.notes: Non-filtered ridge exhaust for warmer climates; 10-inch and 12-inch cap variants both provide 18 sq in/ft. Verify slot and end clearances.
products.availability: GAF roofing distributors and major building-material retailers.

products.name: Cobra RidgeRunner
products.notes: 30-ft roll for 12-inch ridge caps. Filtered model is available in all climates; non-filtered variant is for warmer climates. Cut installed length to fit usable ridge.

products.name: 750-G metal box vent
products.notes: Galvanized metal static exhaust. Distribute near the high portion of the attic. Check installation instructions.
products.availability: Roofing supply houses; verify finish and local stock.

products.name: Master Flow HCD144 metal dome
products.notes: Galvanized steel high-capacity dome. Requires product-specific opening and placement.
products.availability: GAF distributors / roofing retailers; confirm the HCD144 model.

products.name: VentSure InFlow
products.notes: Shingle-over low-roof intake for limited or absent soffit intake; verify unobstructed path into attic.
products.availability: Owens Corning roofing distributors; confirm local availability.

products.name: Cobra IntakePro
products.notes: Low-roof shingle-over intake for pitches 4:12 and greater. Verify openings and an unobstructed path into the attic.
products.availability: GAF distribution and major building-material retailers.

products.name: SV-10 soffit / drip-edge intake
products.notes: 63 sq in per 10-ft section, not 10 sq in per foot. Aluminum combination soffit vent and drip edge; check gutter and fascia detail.

products.name: UltraBreeze HP AB-3523A / AB-3523D · 35W
products.notes: Self-flashing AB-3523A (attached panel) / AB-3523D (detached panel). Manufacturer headline: up to 2,850 sq ft and 1,775 CFM; confirm project sizing. The GEN3 guide recommends at least 6.0 sq ft intake per fan (864 sq in) and 10 ft separation from other fans or passive vents. Metal/tile roofs need the appropriate curb-mount model.
products.availability: Texas manufacturer in Gatesville; authorized distributor network.

products.name: SR1800 Series SR1810 · 35W
products.notes: Manufacturer maximum coverage and airflow are performance headlines. Confirm intake, pitch, sun exposure and number of fans for the actual attic before approval.
products.material: ABS composite hood with aluminum base

products.name: Master Flow GreenMachine PRSOLAR2 · 35W
products.notes: Published sizing table differs from the coverage headline. Use exact recorded rows; other areas need manufacturer sizing confirmation.
